models.summary: A multilingual OCR model for extracting text from images at scale with long-context parsing capabilities.
A 118B-parameter MoE model with 8B activated parameters, designed for agentic coding and long-horizon tasks with native thinking support.
A 250B-parameter MoE model activating 15B per token, built with hybrid attention for efficient long-context agentic and coding tasks.
A multimodal transformer accepting text, image, and audio inputs with sparse MoE for coding, tool-use, and conversational tasks.
A fine-tuned Qwen3.6-27B variant optimized for local inference via GGUF quantization with high performance on reasoning and coding benchmarks.
A 3B-parameter model with looped transformer architecture designed for agentic tool-use, reasoning, and code tasks with strong alignment.
A 27B model quantized to ternary weights for on-device inference, retaining 95% FP16 performance in under 8GB with reasoning.
A long-context flagship model with 1M-token support, flexible reasoning effort levels, and MoE architecture for agentic long-horizon tasks.
A 4B-parameter text-to-image generation and editing model with efficient custom tokenizer and diffusion transformer for native-resolution output.
A 27B model in binary weights for on-device inference, retaining 90% FP16 performance in under 4GB with reasoning support.
